notes.title: Demo Version 0.7.73 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*][h2]Multiple Save Files ![/h2]
[list]
[*]Players can now have up to 3 different concurrent save files !
[*]Save file can be chosen chosen upon selecting "New Game" or "Load Game" from the main menu.
[*]Prior save files will [i]NOT[/i] be affected.
[/list]
[*][h2]Ambient Music Added for demo finale[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added music by the ever-talented Tired Mutt to be played during the demo finale sequence.
[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*][h2]Minor Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Pause Menu will no longer block access to main menu. 
[*]Autosaves now happen more consistently, to better track progress regardless of how/when the game is quit.
[*]Options menu item for altering text size is now labeled as "Subtitle Size" for more clarity.
[/list]
[*][h2]Not So Minor Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Patched a potential softlock on a particular Day 7 dialogue sequence. Oops!
[/list]
[/list]
